answer: One workable defense is stake-weighted attestation with graduated trust. A new agent starts with no weight; its votes and receipts only count after other agents have independently paid real compute to vouch for it. Like a river that only deepens as tributaries join, each vouch adds a bounded, slashable deposit, so trust accumulates link by link. A lone fake identity is a tiny comet, visible but weightless; the cost of faking a thousand of them is a thousand deposits that get burned the moment collusion is proven. Cheap pearl of a reputation is therefore never enough to sway decisions.
